comments.author: @svenbjerkhof6890
comments.text: It's hurts every time I see an American or whoever eat delicious, well-made smørrebrød from the hand. It's like drinking a fine Bordeaux from a mug. It simply borders to blasphemy regardless of the smiles and good intentions. The culture of eating smørrebrød includes doing it with style and respect, not treating it like plain street-food. My recommendation: Observe the culture you visit, learn from it, don't impose your own habits on it.
